description.zh: Hunyuan3D / Meshy 等 provider 的 3D 资产生成入口：选 provider + 输入，产出持久化的游戏可用 3D 资产 manifest。
description.en: 3D asset generation entrypoint for providers like Hunyuan3D and Meshy: pick a provider and input, produce durable game-ready 3D asset manifests.

description.zh: 读取 3D 生成供应商能力矩阵；返回静态、无配额数据。
description.en: Read the 3D generation provider capability matrix. Returns static no-quota data.

description.zh: 列出已生成的持久化 3D 资产 manifest，可按 provider 过滤。
description.en: List durable generated 3D asset manifests, optionally filtered by provider.

description.zh: 生成确定性的 Meshy 文生 3D mock 资产并落盘为持久 manifest；不调用远端。
description.en: Generate a deterministic Meshy text-to-3D mock asset persisted as a durable manifest, with no remote calls.

description.zh: 文生 3D：经 Hunyuan workflow 生成并落盘持久 manifest（cache-first）。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock，保持无配额安全。
description.en: Text-to-3D via Hunyuan workflow, persisted as a durable manifest (cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured (quota-safe).

description.zh: 图生 3D：经 Hunyuan workflow 生成并落盘持久 manifest（cache-first）。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Image-to-3D via Hunyuan workflow, persisted as a durable manifest (cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured.

description.zh: 多视图生 3D：经 Hunyuan workflow 命名视图槽生成并落盘持久 manifest（cache-first）。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Multi-view-to-3D via Hunyuan workflow named view slots, persisted as a durable manifest (cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured.

description.zh: 姿态标准化（Hunyuan REST 子能力，上游预处理）：把简单卡通人物全身图标准化为 A/T-pose，输出图落盘为持久 blob 供后续图生 3D 使用；不产出 3D 资产 manifest。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Pose standardization (Hunyuan REST sub-capability, upstream preprocessing): standardize a simple cartoon full-body character image to an A/T-pose. The output image is persisted as a durable blob for later image-to-3D; it does NOT produce a 3D asset manifest. Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured.
